ownerStatement: Ja, Filip, kao owner Lumen beta testiranja i provider/XUI pristupa, potvrđujem da je isti account/upstream dozvoljen za kontrolisani beta test do 300-500 korisnika. Potvrđujem da beta ne sme koristiti XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround bez moje eksplicitne odluke. U slučaju 401/403/429/5xx eskalacije, playback regresije ili provider overload-a, ja sam decision owner za stop/throttle/rollback.

allowedKeys.retention: Until explicit logout or credential replacement

prohibitedPatterns: Persist plaintext credentials outside approved storage service
Store auth tokens in query-string snapshots
Use unbounded history retention for watch behavior data

retentionPolicy.notes: Retention policy must be re-validated before each release candidate freeze.

incidentReadiness.responseChannel: Manual beta/security escalation channel agreed by Filip; private Telegram/Discord/email endpoint is not stored in release artifacts.
incidentReadiness.notes: Filip is the beta security/privacy incident owner. Use the release runbook and manual escalation route for controlled beta incidents.

controls.description: Client storage keys are namespaced and versioned where applicable.
Credential storage is removed on explicit logout path.
Retention bounds exist for each stored data class.
Incident response owner and runbook reference are defined.

signoff.notes: Storage inventory, retention controls, credential cleanup evidence, incident owner, runbook, response channel, and beta security/privacy signoff are recorded.
